name: stop-review
description: When a turn ends, checks the final answer's format (a `Checked:` list after a change, no work parked under a heading the report has no list for, no question outside `Decision needed:`), asks the advisorModel to review a tool-using turn against ~/AGENTS.md and the skill procedures appended after it, and sends the turn back once with every finding; an answer another Stop hook sends back, such as /goal, waits for the answer that ends the turn.
